modelingNotes: Exact 8575/12-200 selection: CES 16 A extra-low-voltage plug, three poles, 20–25 V, violet, 50/60 Hz. No dedicated PE or neutral contact. Different orders and successors are not substituted.

Manufacturer plug diagram 09193E00 on E3/2 explicitly labels L1, L2 and L3. These are contact markings, not an assigned circuit phase map. C/M distinguish cable termination from mating contact; individual clamp legends and installed orientation remain unverified.
Three fixed plug paths C.L1–M.L1, C.L2–M.L2, C.L3–M.L3 represent passive hardware continuity. They must be explicit project jumpers; bus/connector functions do not join nets.

Rated current 16 A; coded operating range 20–25 V AC, 50/60 Hz. Family maximum voltage capability is not encoded as rating.nominal_voltage because the compiler treats that field as an exact voltage compatibility constraint.
Mechanical keying has a main keyway and no auxiliary keyway for this selection. No physical pin coordinates, field phase assignment or mating assembly certification is asserted.
Older catalog selection reports 0.35 kg; the 2010 exact selection reports 0.230 kg. Installed revision is unknown; no mass or environmental rating is encoded.
Terminals are application-dependent. No accessory or host housing is included in this type; installed accessory presence is unverified.

connectionCoverage.notes: Three cable-side functional endpoints and three mating contacts, with verified manufacturer L1/L2/L3 legends from plug diagram09193E00. C/M are authoring-side aliases; exact clamp legends and installed orientation remain unverified. No dedicated PE or neutral. Three fixed paths are explicit source jumpers.
